- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/30 (Tue) 13:25
- [EVENT] User is planning a trip to Berlin in August.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Average high temperature in Berlin in August: 23°C (73°F).
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Average low temperature in Berlin in August: 13°C (56°F).
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] August is usually one of the warmest months in Berlin, with temperatures often reaching the mid-20s (around 77°F) on some days.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Berlin receives an average of 9 hours of sunshine per day in August.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Average of 12 rainy days throughout the month of August in Berlin.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Relative humidity in August is around 60-70%.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Packing tips for Berlin trip: 
  - Lightweight and breathable clothing for warm days
  - Comfortable shoes for walking and exploring
  - Layers for cooler mornings and evenings (t-shirts, sweaters, light jackets)
  - Rain gear (umbrella or waterproof jacket)
  - Sun protection (sunscreen, sunglasses, hat)
- [EVENT] User is considering getting a new suitcase.
- [PREFERENCE] User is eyeing Rimowa but has heard mixed reviews.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Pros of Rimowa:
  - High-quality, durable, and lightweight polycarbonate construction
  - Sleek, stylish design associated with luxury travel
  - Smooth, quiet wheels and comfortable handle
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Cons of Rimowa:
  - Can be quite expensive
  - Some users reported issues with handles breaking or shells cracking
  - Polycarbonate material can be prone to scratches and scuffs
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Alternative hard-shell suitcase options:
  - Tumi: High-quality, durable luggage with advanced features
  - Samsonite: Variety of hard-shell cases at different price points, known for durability
  - Delsey: Stylish, high-quality hard-shell cases with advanced features
  - Calpak: Affordable option with modern designs and functional features
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Considerations when choosing a hard-shell suitcase:
  - Size based on travel style
  - Weight of the suitcase
  - Durability of materials
  - Important features (TSA-approved locks, built-in chargers, spinner wheels)
  - Price range
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommendations for packing lists and strategies to avoid overpacking:
  - Plan outfits based on activities and weather
  - Pack multipurpose items
